item.title: Play Developer Subscriptions and In-App Purchases API: We're investigating reports of an issue with Play Developer Subscriptions and In-App Purchases API. We will provide more information shortly. The affected users [service_disruption]
item.description: We're investigating reports of an issue with Play Developer Subscriptions and In-App Purchases API. We will provide more information shortly. The affected users are able to access Play Developer Subscriptions and In-App Purchases API, but may experience delays in sending or receiving messages. Most developers are experiencing high latency with real time developer notifications.
